    runtime = result.nfev  # Number of function evaluations
    evaluation_cost = runtime * 1  # Assuming 1 unit cost per function evaluation
    achieved_cost = 80 * sum(x_opt)  # Total achieved cost
    activated_units = [i for i, v in enumerate(x_opt) if v == 1]
    total_output_kw = sum([v for i, v in enumerate(x_opt) if v == 1][0] * resources[i]["output_kW"])
